purpose: Clean v4 reference and depth-9 timestamp component under an isolated run root; original scientific settings, independently rebuilt parent bytes and new receipts
replica_of: published local v4 sequential reference and original v5 timestamp expert component
upstream_prerequisites: Independent clean v3 lobt pipeline with its baseline, ensemble and lobt parent reports, models, OOF and ranking output
Independent clean v4 GPU original-fold OOF, final GPU ranking blend and model receipts
Independent clean v4 source-classifier original-fold OOF, final source ranking probabilities, sequential ranking prediction and model receipts
Twelve 2025 raw files, 2026 ranking and submission template, baseline training/ranking rows and features, NOAA weather

scientific_choices.v4_reference: Call v4_reference.load_v4(root=isolated_run_root, verify_snapshot=False); require exact independently rebuilt parent IDs, finite labels, month/fold/time and nonnegative clipping. The optional historical RMSE equality is not a gate on new GPU bytes. Inherited original-v3 heldout scores used some held labels for early stopping and policy selection and are indicative, as the pinned legacy-validation erratum records.
scientific_choices.timestamp_model: Call deep_timestamp_expert.load_features and fit_fold with explicit isolated source/cache/output paths. GPU CatBoost residual, requested 4500 trees, depth 9, seed 2026, 2 CPU threads for data operations, original params, internal 6 percent shuffled early stop with at least 20000 rows and patience 200. Fit and early stop exclude heldout months.
scientific_choices.features: Exact published timestamp/flight/weather feature order and category levels; only ranking-available projected raw fields. No departure BLOCK_TIME_UTC_mvt or TAXITIME_SEC_mvt feature.
scientific_choices.validation_gate: Recompute every all-finite fold score from saved OOF; January/July must select fixed 0.5 by original smaller-weight tie rule, and unchanged 0.5 must improve November/December versus zero. Failure is terminal with no weight search.
scientific_choices.all_finite_policy: Apply deep timestamp expert only where the own AOBT proxy is finite and 0..7200; use clip(v4 + 0.5*(deep_raw-v4),0); all other rows retain the clipped v4 parent prediction exactly.
scientific_choices.final_model: All 2025 rows with finite target 0..86400 and finite own proxy 0..7200; median integer of only original Jan/Jul and Nov/Dec saved tree counts; otherwise same published CatBoost params and feature order.
scientific_choices.ranking: Seal every ranking source, cache, model and template byte before value read; exact 344841 template IDs/order, valid-proxy fixed 0.5 blend against independently rebuilt v4 sequential parent ranking prediction, every invalid-proxy row unchanged, finite nonnegative readback. No finalizer or upload.

run_isolation.source_repository_supplies: published source and this spec only
run_isolation.publication_trust_boundary: A supplied source SHA is an operator publication attestation. Equality to local bytes alone does not prove a public commit; verify the source commit before any real mode.

provenance.parent_receipts: Named independent v3/lobt, GPU and source producer receipts must bind all own raw/cache/weather input SHAs, relevant upstream output SHAs, source commit/source hashes, parameter/split choices, model/report/OOF/ranking output SHAs and ordered IDs. The v3 receipt must truthfully state fit exclusion with heldout-label early stopping and original policy selection. GPU/source receipts state only their own component's heldout exclusion and the inherited-v3 limitation. No historical private artifact byte hashes are authentication pins.
provenance.adapter_receipts: Rehash all parent/source/spec bytes before and after each operation; record exact schema/category vocabularies, fit/early/held ID hashes, saved model parameters and tree count, OOF model readback predictions, all-finite score replay, full-training ID hash, template/ranking input seal, invalid-row equality and final Parquet readback.
provenance.failure_policy: Any missing/changed parent, schema, model replay, split, selected-weight or output check refuses dependent stages. No retuning, resume or overwrite.

scope_limit: This is a v4 reference and timestamp component adapter, not a complete v3-v13 clean reproduction driver. Independent v3, GPU and source builders/receipts must be supplied first; missing-clock, clean arrival and later adapters remain separate. Reproduction does not claim byte-identical GPU outputs or official score transfer.
